findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?token={token}" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contacts_search, inboxes_get, inboxes_get_agent_bot, inbox_members_list, inbox_members_update, messages_list, message_templates_list, reports_account_summary, reports_v2_inboxes, scheduled_messages_list · Private data: contact_labels_list, contact_labels_set, contacts_list, contacts_create, contacts_get, contacts_update, contacts_delete, contacts_conversations, contacts_search, contacts_filter, contacts_create_contact_inbox, contacts_contactable_inboxes, contacts_merge, labels_create, labels_delete, scheduled_messages_create_from_template · Public sink: contacts_create, contacts_search, contacts_filter, integrations_create_hook, messages_create, webhooks_create, webhooks_update, webhooks_delete · Destructive: agent_bots_delete, agents_delete, automation_rules_delete, canned_responses_delete, contacts_delete, custom_attributes_delete, custom_filters_delete, inbox_members_delete, integrations_delete_hook, kanban_boards_delete, kanban_steps_delete, kanban_tasks_delete, labels_delete, messages_delete, scheduled_messages_delete, teams_delete, team_members_delete, webhooks_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contacts_search, inboxes_get, inboxes_get_agent_bot, inbox_members_list, inbox_members_update, messages_list, message_templates_list, reports_account_summary, reports_v2_inboxes, scheduled_messages_list · Private data: contact_labels_list, contact_labels_set, contacts_list, contacts_create, contacts_get, contacts_update, contacts_delete, contacts_conversations, contacts_search, contacts_filter, contacts_create_contact_inbox, contacts_contactable_inboxes, contacts_merge, labels_create, labels_delete, scheduled_messages_create_from_template · Public sink: contacts_create, contacts_search, contacts_filter, integrations_create_hook, messages_create, webhooks_create, webhooks_update, webhooks_delete · Destructive: agent_bots_delete, agents_delete, automation_rules_delete, canned_responses_delete, contacts_delete, custom_attributes_delete, custom_filters_delete, inbox_members_delete, integrations_delete_hook, kanban_boards_delete, kanban_steps_delete, kanban_tasks_delete, labels_delete, messages_delete, scheduled_messages_delete, teams_delete, team_members_delete, webhooks_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
